# Third-party assets

- MediaPipe Tasks Vision 0.10.21 JavaScript and WebAssembly runtime: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@mediapipe/tasks-vision/v/0.10.21
- Official hand-landmarker float16 v1 model: https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/hand_landmarker/hand_landmarker/float16/1/hand_landmarker.task
- MediaPipe source and license: https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe (Apache License 2.0).

Runtime files were downloaded from jsDelivr's version-pinned npm distribution. The model was downloaded from Google's official model storage. These assets are served locally by this project. MediaPipe performs landmark detection; the heart/circle geometry rules are application code.
